method: Built-in image_gen__imagegen color/lightness edit; no CLI and no raster post-processing
prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: opaque production2D RPG whole-map tavern floor/background. Edit this EXACT supplied1330x1182 map only for COLOR AND LIGHTNESS, preserving pixel-aligned composition and its complete geometry. Keep the1330x1182 canvas, crop, overhead camera, EVERY plank edge, woodgrain/knot/crack, wall, trim, partition, doorway gap, table, stool, bench, barrel, lantern, candle, plant, cloth, paper, dishes and tiny tabletop object in EXACTLY the same position, size and shape. No new object, moved object, erased object, changed doorway or new texture layout.
The main FLOOR currently shares too much yellow-brown with the leather-clothed player. Recolor ONLY the broad wooden FLOOR surface into convincingly weathered GREY OAK: distinctly COOL, low-saturation slate-grey brown/ash-grey oak, a subtle neutral blue-grey mineral undertone, natural aged wood grain still clearly visible. The floor should be a little DARKER and QUIETER in midtones than this source, not pitch black and not honey/orange/sienna. Preserve every existing plank seam and grain geometry while changing its hue/value. This cool quiet floor must provide readable separation for a deep-brown leather, ivory-shirt, muted-teal-cloak human character; do NOT draw that character in the image. Avoid fake painted blue boards or excessively cyan wood. Believable natural cool weathered grey oak, with varied grey-brown grain and a calm matte surface.
Retain full natural color on all furniture/tabletop objects: red cloth stays red, books/paper remain their source colors, paper ivory, living plant green, warm brass and subtle brown table/bench/barrel wood retained. Keep the existing stone/trim grey. This is NOT an overall grey/desaturation filter over the room. Keep existing amber flames and WARM LOCAL LIGHT only immediately beside the existing lanterns and candles; those pools may gently warm nearby floor patches but must fade quickly into the cool room ambient. Outside those local pools the floor must remain visibly cool and distinct from warm leather. No added global orange light, no new lights, no full-scene blue filter, no heavy vignette, no darkness obscuring texture.
Critical invariants repeated: source map layout, walls, table/bench/lantern/door coordinates, object silhouettes and wood texture geometry unchanged; color and lightness refinement only. No UI, text, people, new props, watermark or border. Preserve original opaque1330x1182 output dimensions exactly.

visualInspection.floor: Visibly cooler slate-grey weathered oak, lower warm brown saturation; wood grain remains visible.
visualInspection.objects: Existing furniture, walls, partition gaps, lantern positions, red tablecloth, ivory papers and green plant retained by visual inspection.
visualInspection.limits: Generated editing can redraw fine grain and minor object details. This is not a claim of pixel-identical texture geometry; native side-by-side review is still required.
